blocks.zh: 繁體中文解析
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: 14.1 附錄導論
blocks.en: 14.1 Introduction to the Appendix

blocks.zh: 附錄的核心目的
blocks.en: Core Purpose of the Appendix

blocks.zh: 本附錄提供四個真實情境案例，示範如何將 Risk-MaPP 工具實際應用於多產品製造設施中的新產品引入決策。重點在於說明：表面看起來有問題的設施，透過嚴謹的 QRMP 分析，可能仍可安全生產；反之，看似沒問題的情況，可能隱藏著關鍵風險。
blocks.en: This appendix presents four realistic scenarios showing how Risk-MaPP tools are applied to decisions on introducing new products into a multi-product manufacturing facility. The key message: a facility that looks problematic on the surface may still be able to produce safely after rigorous QRMP analysis, while a situation that looks fine may hide a critical risk.

blocks.zh: 重要聲明
blocks.en: Important Disclaimer

blocks.zh: 這些案例不是「標準答案」或可引用的先例。每個設施情況不同，不可直接套用。案例的價值在於展示思考過程，而非提供固定結論。
blocks.en: These scenarios are not "model answers" or precedents to be cited. Every facility is different, and the scenarios cannot be applied directly. Their value lies in showing the thought process, not in providing fixed conclusions.

blocks.zh: 四個情境概覽
blocks.en: Overview of the Four Scenarios

blocks.zh: 情境一（明顯可接受）：引入相似類型的抗高血壓藥，風險輪廓相近，評估過程直接清晰。
blocks.en: Scenario 1 (obviously acceptable): introduction of a similar type of antihypertensive with a comparable risk profile; the assessment is straightforward.

blocks.zh: 情境二（表面可接受，但實際不可）：引入抗腫瘤藥，最終因清潔驗證瓶頸而放棄。
blocks.en: Scenario 2 (apparently acceptable, but actually not): introduction of an antineoplastic drug, ultimately abandoned because of a cleaning validation bottleneck.

blocks.zh: 情境三（表面不可接受，但實際可以）：引入性荷爾蒙，透過工程控制最終獲批。
blocks.en: Scenario 3 (apparently unacceptable, but actually acceptable): introduction of a sex hormone, ultimately approved through engineering controls.

blocks.zh: 情境四：現有設施多產品組合的全面評估。
blocks.en: Scenario 4: a comprehensive assessment of the multi-product mix in an existing facility.

blocks.zh: 如何閱讀這些案例
blocks.en: How to Read These Scenarios

blocks.zh: 情境一至三使用同一個基礎設施（Kingswood, CT），只有引入的新 API 不同。這個設計讓讀者能直接比較：同一個廠房，引入不同風險等級的化合物，決策路徑如何分岐。把它想成「同一個廚房，做不同料理」——設備一樣，但某些食材的交叉污染風險就是不一樣。
blocks.en: Scenarios 1 to 3 use the same base facility (Kingswood, CT); only the new API introduced differs. This design lets readers compare directly how the decision path diverges when compounds of different risk levels are introduced into the same building. Think of it as "the same kitchen cooking different dishes": the equipment is the same, but the cross-contamination risk of certain ingredients is simply different.

blocks.zh: Logic Diagram 的作用
blocks.en: The Role of the Logic Diagram

blocks.zh: Logic Diagram（第 14.6 節）是整個評估流程的導引工具，類似決策樹。評估團隊從第一個問題出發，逐步回答每個節點，最終得出是否需要隔離設施，或是否可以透過工程控制解決問題。每個情境的評估都從這裡開始。
blocks.en: The Logic Diagram (Section 14.6) is the guiding tool for the whole assessment process and works like a decision tree. The assessment team starts from the first question and answers each node in turn, finally concluding whether a dedicated facility is needed or whether the problem can be solved through engineering controls. The assessment in every scenario starts here.

blocks.zh: CDMO 操作要點
blocks.en: Key Points for CDMO Operations

blocks.zh: 當客戶要求導入新產品時，根據此框架，QRMP 應納入變更控制（Change Control）程序中正式執行，而不是個案討論。跨部門指導委員會（含毒理、EHS、法規、生產、清潔驗證）的組建是成功評估的前提條件。
blocks.en: When a client asks to introduce a new product, under this framework the QRMP should be carried out formally within the change control procedure rather than discussed case by case. Forming a cross-functional steering committee (including toxicology, EHS, regulatory, production and cleaning validation) is a prerequisite for a successful assessment.

blocks.zh: 14.2 情境一：明顯可接受
blocks.en: 14.2 Scenario 1: Obviously Acceptable

blocks.zh: 情境一 — Obviously Acceptable
blocks.en: Scenario 1 - Obviously Acceptable

blocks.zh: 情境設定：為何「明顯可接受」？
blocks.en: Scenario Setup: Why Is It "Obviously Acceptable"?

blocks.zh: 業主希望將一個新的抗高血壓藥 Antitense™ 引入現有設施。此設施已有一個相同治療類別的抗高血壓藥在生產中（Anti-hypertensive A，ADE = 0.5 mg/day）。新產品的 ADE 為 0.3 mg/day，略低於現有品，但屬於同一數量級，且現有清潔流程已被驗證能控制類似風險。
blocks.en: The owner wants to introduce a new antihypertensive, Antitense™, into the existing facility. The facility already manufactures an antihypertensive of the same therapeutic class (Anti-hypertensive A, ADE = 0.5 mg/day). The ADE of the new product is 0.3 mg/day, slightly lower than the existing product but of the same order of magnitude, and the existing cleaning process has already been validated to control similar risks.

blocks.zh: 關鍵數據解讀：ADE 比較
blocks.en: Interpreting the Key Data: ADE Comparison

blocks.zh: Antitense™ 的 ADE = 0.3 mg/day，計算如下：
blocks.en: The ADE of Antitense™ = 0.3 mg/day, calculated as follows:

blocks.zh: 臨床最低治療劑量：10 mg/day
blocks.en: Minimum clinical therapeutic dose: 10 mg/day

blocks.zh: 個體間差異調整因子（AFH）：10
blocks.en: Adjustment factor for inter-individual variability (AFH): 10

blocks.zh: 外推至無效應劑量的調整因子（AFL）：3
blocks.en: Adjustment factor for extrapolation to a no-effect dose (AFL): 3

blocks.zh: 與現有 Anti-hypertensive A（ADE = 0.5）相比，Antitense™ 只是稍微更嚴格，並未跨越一個數量級的門檻。
blocks.en: Compared with the existing Anti-hypertensive A (ADE = 0.5), Antitense™ is only slightly more stringent and does not cross an order-of-magnitude threshold.

blocks.zh: 設施條件：重要背景
blocks.en: Facility Conditions: Important Background

blocks.zh: 此情境中的設施使用空氣循環（recirculation）系統，這在後續情境二中會是一個問題點。情境一之所以能接受，部分原因是引入的化合物風險等級與現有品相當，不需要特殊隔離設計。
blocks.en: The facility in this scenario uses an air recirculation system, which becomes a problem point in Scenario 2. Scenario 1 is acceptable partly because the introduced compound has a risk level comparable to the existing product and does not require a special containment design.

blocks.zh: 設施特點：單一通道設計、共用走廊、同時最多加工兩種化合物。
blocks.en: Facility features: single-pass design, shared corridors, up to two compounds processed at the same time.

blocks.zh: 風險評估解析
blocks.en: Risk Assessment Analysis

blocks.zh: ADE 推導邏輯（關鍵概念）
blocks.en: ADE Derivation Logic (Key Concept)

blocks.zh: ADE（Acceptable Daily Exposure，每日可接受暴露量）是整個 Risk-MaPP 評估的基石。其推導流程：
blocks.en: The ADE (Acceptable Daily Exposure) is the cornerstone of the whole Risk-MaPP assessment. The derivation proceeds as follows:

blocks.zh: 文獻回顧：找出化合物所有不良反應
blocks.en: Literature review: identify all adverse effects of the compound

blocks.zh: 識別「關鍵效應」（critical effect）：劑量-反應曲線低端的第一個不良效應
blocks.en: Identify the "critical effect": the first adverse effect at the low end of the dose-response curve

blocks.zh: 找出該效應的無不良效應劑量（NOAEL 或等效值）
blocks.en: Find the no-observed-adverse-effect level (NOAEL or equivalent) for that effect

blocks.zh: 除以適當的調整因子（AFH、AFL 等）得出 ADE
blocks.en: Divide by the appropriate adjustment factors (AFH, AFL, etc.) to obtain the ADE

blocks.zh: 用 ADE 推算清潔驗證目標值（cleaning limits）
blocks.en: Use the ADE to derive the cleaning validation target values (cleaning limits)

blocks.zh: 思考框架：比較風險，而非絕對風險
blocks.en: Framework for Thinking: Compare Risks Rather Than Judging Absolute Risk

blocks.zh: 風險評估的關鍵洞察：不是問「這個新化合物安不安全？」而是問「這個新化合物的風險，比我們現在已在生產的化合物更高嗎？」。如果現有系統已成功控制 Anti-hypertensive A（ADE 0.5），那麼 ADE 0.3 的 Antitense™ 只需驗證清潔效果稍微更嚴格即可，不需要重新設計設施。
blocks.en: The key insight of risk assessment is to ask not "is this new compound safe?" but "is the risk of this new compound higher than that of the compounds we already manufacture?". If the existing system already controls Anti-hypertensive A (ADE 0.5) successfully, then for Antitense™ with an ADE of 0.3 it is only necessary to verify that cleaning meets a slightly stricter target, with no need to redesign the facility.

blocks.zh: Risk Evaluation 的速捷判斷
blocks.en: Quick Judgment in the Risk Evaluation

blocks.zh: 「The analysis quickly showed that the new compound posed less risk than some compounds already in manufacture」——這句話是情境一成立的核心。現有監測資料已顯示設施可控制更高挑戰性的化合物，新品的 ADE 雖稍低，但整體風險輪廓未超出現有能力範圍。
blocks.en: "The analysis quickly showed that the new compound posed less risk than some compounds already in manufacture": this sentence is the core of why Scenario 1 holds. Existing monitoring data already show that the facility can control more challenging compounds, and although the ADE of the new product is slightly lower, its overall risk profile does not exceed the existing capability.

blocks.zh: 情境一：CDMO 結論與應用啟示
blocks.en: Scenario 1: CDMO Conclusion and Practical Implications

blocks.zh: 為何評估「快速」完成？
blocks.en: Why Was the Assessment Completed "Quickly"?

blocks.zh: 情境一之所以稱為「Obviously Acceptable」，是因為：
blocks.en: Scenario 1 is called "Obviously Acceptable" because:

blocks.zh: 新品與現有品屬同一藥理類別（抗高血壓），毒理輪廓相似
blocks.en: The new and existing products belong to the same pharmacological class (antihypertensives) with similar toxicological profiles

blocks.zh: 新品 ADE（0.3 mg/day）與現有品（0.5 mg/day）在同一數量級
blocks.en: The ADE of the new product (0.3 mg/day) and that of the existing product (0.5 mg/day) are of the same order of magnitude

blocks.zh: 現有清潔流程已被歷史數據驗證能達到更嚴格的要求
blocks.en: The existing cleaning process has already been shown by historical data to meet the stricter requirement

blocks.zh: 現有監測數據庫充足，不需要額外的暴露評估
blocks.en: The existing monitoring database is sufficient and no additional exposure assessment is needed

blocks.zh: Logic Diagram 路徑（情境一）
blocks.en: Logic Diagram Path (Scenario 1)

blocks.zh:
新 API 的風險等級是否超過現有產品？
答：否（ADE 相似，同類藥物）
blocks.en:
Does the risk level of the new API exceed that of existing products?
Answer: No (similar ADE, same class of drug)

blocks.zh:
現有清潔系統能否達到新的清潔限值？
答：是（歷史數據顯示現有程序可達）
blocks.en:
Can the existing cleaning system meet the new cleaning limit?
Answer: Yes (historical data show the existing procedure can achieve it)

blocks.zh: 結論
blocks.en: Conclusion

blocks.zh: 可引入，無需設施改造。納入現有 QRMP 範疇，更新清潔驗證目標值即可。
blocks.en: It can be introduced without facility modification. It falls within the scope of the existing QRMP, and only the cleaning validation target values need to be updated.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務啟示
blocks.en: Practical Implications for a CDMO

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，情境一代表最理想的新產品引入情況：客戶帶來的新品與現有產品在毒理學上可比較，且設施已有相應的控制能力。關鍵文件工作：更新 QRMP 以納入新品，更新清潔驗證計劃（cleaning validation plan）以反映略微更嚴格的目標值，並確認現有 SOP 覆蓋新品的所有製程步驟。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, Scenario 1 represents the ideal case for introducing a new product: the client's new product is toxicologically comparable to the existing products, and the facility already has the corresponding control capability. Key documentation work: update the QRMP to include the new product, update the cleaning validation plan to reflect the slightly stricter target values, and confirm that the existing SOPs cover all process steps for the new product.

blocks.zh: 14.3 情境二：表面可接受（但實際不可）
blocks.en: 14.3 Scenario 2: Apparently Acceptable (but Actually Not)

blocks.zh: 情境二 — Apparently Acceptable (but was NOT)
blocks.en: Scenario 2 - Apparently Acceptable (but was NOT)

blocks.zh: 情境設定：為何「表面可接受」？
blocks.en: Scenario Setup: Why Is It "Apparently Acceptable"?

blocks.zh: 業主希望引入抗腫瘤藥 Anti-neoplastic Agent C，一種烷化劑。初步看來，業主已:
blocks.en: The owner wants to introduce an antineoplastic drug, Anti-neoplastic Agent C, an alkylating agent. At first glance, the owner has already:

blocks.zh: 在設施中大量投入工程控制（隔離器、密閉傳輸、獨立空調）
blocks.en: Invested heavily in engineering controls in the facility (isolators, closed transfer, dedicated air handling)

blocks.zh: 建立完整的 SOP 體系（進出人員管制、清潔程序等）
blocks.en: Established a complete SOP system (personnel entry/exit control, cleaning procedures, etc.)

blocks.zh: 使用一次性通風（once-through）以避免循環污染
blocks.en: Used once-through ventilation to avoid recirculation contamination

blocks.zh: 光看工程控制清單，似乎已做到位。問題出在哪裡？
blocks.en: Judging by the list of engineering controls alone, everything seems to be in place. So where does the problem lie?

blocks.zh: 關鍵差異：ADE 數量級的跳躍
blocks.en: Key Difference: A Jump in the Order of Magnitude of the ADE

blocks.zh: Anti-neoplastic Agent C 的 ADE = 0.001 mg/day（即 1 μg/day），遠低於設施現有化合物：
blocks.en: The ADE of Anti-neoplastic Agent C = 0.001 mg/day (i.e. 1 μg/day), far lower than that of the compounds already in the facility:

blocks.zh: Antacid：50 mg/day（高出 50,000 倍）
blocks.en: Antacid: 50 mg/day (50,000 times higher)

blocks.zh: Anti-hypertensive：0.5 mg/day（高出 500 倍）
blocks.en: Anti-hypertensive: 0.5 mg/day (500 times higher)

blocks.zh: NSAID：40 mg/day（高出 40,000 倍）
blocks.en: NSAID: 40 mg/day (40,000 times higher)

blocks.zh: 這個數量級的差距，意味著清潔限值的要求將比現有設備歷史表現嚴格得多。
blocks.en: A gap of this magnitude means the cleaning limit requirement will be far stricter than the historical performance of the existing equipment.

blocks.zh: 為何 ADE 如此低？
blocks.en: Why Is the ADE So Low?

blocks.zh: Anti-neoplastic Agent C 是一種直接作用型基因毒性致癌物（direct acting genotoxic material）。其毒理特性：
blocks.en: Anti-neoplastic Agent C is a direct acting genotoxic carcinogen. Its toxicological characteristics:

blocks.zh: 烷化劑，干擾 DNA 複製與 RNA 轉錄
blocks.en: An alkylating agent that interferes with DNA replication and RNA transcription

blocks.zh: 動物試驗：低至 2.5 mg/kg/day 即產生發育毒性
blocks.en: Animal studies: developmental toxicity at doses as low as 2.5 mg/kg/day

blocks.zh: 損傷成年大鼠精子 DNA
blocks.en: Damages sperm DNA in adult rats

blocks.zh: 多種動物中增加惡性腫瘤發生率
blocks.en: Increases the incidence of malignant tumors in multiple animal species

blocks.zh: 人類研究確認具致癌性
blocks.en: Human studies confirm carcinogenicity

blocks.zh: ADE 推算基於癌症風險外推，1 μg/day 對應 1 × 10⁻⁵ 的額外癌症風險（即百萬分之十的超額風險）。
blocks.en: The ADE is derived by cancer risk extrapolation: 1 μg/day corresponds to an additional cancer risk of 1 × 10⁻⁵ (i.e. an excess risk of ten in a million).

blocks.zh: 「Once-Through」vs「循環」通風的意義
blocks.en: The Significance of "Once-Through" vs. "Recirculation" Ventilation

blocks.zh: 情境一設施使用空氣循環（recirculation），對於情境二這樣的高毒性化合物是不可接受的風險。業主在情境二中已切換為一次通過式（once-through）通風——這是正確的工程決策，確保空氣中的微粒不會在設施內循環。
blocks.en: The Scenario 1 facility uses air recirculation, which is an unacceptable risk for a highly toxic compound such as the one in Scenario 2. In Scenario 2 the owner has switched to once-through ventilation, which is the correct engineering decision and ensures that airborne particles do not circulate within the facility.

blocks.zh: 工程控制架構（情境二特有）
blocks.en: Engineering Control Architecture (Specific to Scenario 2)

blocks.zh: 情境二中導入的控制措施比情境一更全面，包括：
blocks.en: The controls introduced in Scenario 2 are more comprehensive than in Scenario 1 and include:

blocks.zh: 隔離器（Isolator）：取樣、稱重在隔離器內進行
blocks.en: Isolators: sampling and weighing are performed inside isolators

blocks.zh: 密閉傳輸：Split Butterfly Valve（SBV）、Rapid Transfer Port（RTP）
blocks.en: Closed transfer: Split Butterfly Valve (SBV), Rapid Transfer Port (RTP)

blocks.zh: 房間邊界 HEPA 過濾：風扇輔助安全換氣，防止逸散 API 進入 HVAC
blocks.en: HEPA filtration at the room boundary: fan-assisted safe-change filtration to prevent escaped API from entering the HVAC

blocks.zh: 電子門禁：條碼讀取器控制人員與物料流動，走廊內強制 1 分鐘間隔
blocks.en: Electronic access control: barcode readers control the movement of personnel and materials, with a mandatory 1-minute interval in the corridor

blocks.zh: 就地密閉清洗（CIP）：設備離開製程室前先進行密閉式清潔
blocks.en: Clean-in-place (CIP): equipment is cleaned in a closed manner before it leaves the process room

blocks.zh: 製程設備：密閉系統設計要點
blocks.en: Process Equipment: Key Points of Closed-System Design

blocks.zh: 密閉系統的設計邏輯
blocks.en: Design Logic of the Closed System

blocks.zh: 整個製程設計圍繞一個核心原則：在任何可能產生逸散 API 的節點，全面實施密閉操作。重要設備節點：
blocks.en: The whole process is designed around one core principle: fully closed operation at every point where API could escape. The key equipment points:

blocks.zh: 隔離器（Isolator）：取樣、稱重、造粒
blocks.en: Isolator: sampling, weighing, granulation

blocks.zh: Split Butterfly Valve（SBV）：所有物料傳輸密閉接口
blocks.en: Split Butterfly Valve (SBV): all closed material transfer interfaces

blocks.zh: Rapid Transfer Port（RTP）：實驗室樣品傳遞
blocks.en: Rapid Transfer Port (RTP): transfer of laboratory samples

blocks.zh: 流化床乾燥器：密閉操作、真空排料
blocks.en: Fluid bed dryer: closed operation, vacuum discharge

blocks.zh: V-Blender（V 型混合機）：物料進出均使用 SBV
blocks.en: V-Blender: material in and out through SBVs

blocks.zh: Logic Diagram 路徑（情境二——初步評估）
blocks.en: Logic Diagram Path (Scenario 2: Initial Assessment)

blocks.zh: Q：需要隔離？
blocks.en: Q: Is containment needed?

blocks.zh:
Anti-neoplastic ADE = 0.001 mg/day，屬高活性化合物（HPAPI）
→ 需要工程控制
blocks.en:
Anti-neoplastic ADE = 0.001 mg/day, a highly potent compound (HPAPI)
→ Engineering controls are needed

blocks.zh: Q：工程控制夠用？
blocks.en: Q: Are the engineering controls sufficient?

blocks.zh:
已安裝隔離器、密閉傳輸、once-through 通風、門禁
→ 表面上看似充足
blocks.en:
Isolators, closed transfer, once-through ventilation and access control are installed
→ Appears adequate on the surface

blocks.zh: Q：清潔可達標？
blocks.en: Q: Can cleaning meet the target?

blocks.zh:
需要進一步 FMEA 分析…
→ 此處發現問題
blocks.en:
Further FMEA analysis is needed...
→ The problem is found here

blocks.zh: HVAC 與 SOP 系統解析
blocks.en: Analysis of the HVAC and SOP Systems

blocks.zh: 多重氣流屏障設計
blocks.en: Multiple Airflow Barrier Design

blocks.zh: 情境二的 HVAC 設計展示了「縱深防禦（defence in depth）」原則：即使製程室發生逸散事件，污染物仍需突破多個屏障才能進入走廊或其他製程室：
blocks.en: The Scenario 2 HVAC design demonstrates the principle of "defence in depth": even if a release occurs in the process room, the contaminant still has to breach multiple barriers before reaching the corridor or other process rooms:

blocks.zh: 製程室本身負壓（相對走廊）
blocks.en: The process room itself is at negative pressure (relative to the corridor)

blocks.zh: 門廳（airlock）的吹掃延遲
blocks.en: Purge delay in the airlock

blocks.zh: 走廊正壓（相對製程室）
blocks.en: The corridor is at positive pressure (relative to the process room)

blocks.zh: 排氣雙重 HEPA 過濾（99.997% × 2）
blocks.en: Double HEPA filtration of the exhaust (99.997% × 2)

blocks.zh: 一次通過式通風（無循環風險）
blocks.en: Once-through ventilation (no recirculation risk)

blocks.zh: SOPs 的 FMEA 驅動設計
blocks.en: FMEA-Driven SOP Design

blocks.zh: 值得注意的是：SOP 清單中包含「Upset recovery protocols」（異常恢復程序）。這表明評估團隊認識到，即使在正常操作時系統可控，但當發生設備異常（如密封失效、溢漏）時，需要預定義的應對程序。此類「最壞情境」SOP 是 HPAPI 設施的必要文件。
blocks.en: Note that the SOP list includes "Upset recovery protocols". This shows that the assessment team recognized that, although the system is controlled during normal operation, predefined response procedures are needed when an equipment upset occurs (such as a seal failure or spill). This kind of "worst-case scenario" SOP is an essential document for an HPAPI facility.

blocks.zh: 「表面可接受」的陷阱
blocks.en: The Trap of "Apparently Acceptable"

blocks.zh: 此時，若只看工程控制清單——隔離器、SBV、HEPA、電子門禁——的確看起來很完整。但 Risk-MaPP 的力量在於不允許評估在此止步。FMEA 強制團隊逐一檢視每個製程步驟的殘留風險，其中隱藏的炸彈在下一步才被發現。
blocks.en: At this point, looking only at the list of engineering controls (isolators, SBVs, HEPA, electronic access control), it does look complete. But the strength of Risk-MaPP is that it does not allow the assessment to stop here. The FMEA forces the team to examine the residue risk at each process step one by one, and the hidden bomb is only found in the next step.

blocks.zh: 風險評估深度解析
blocks.en: In-Depth Analysis of the Risk Assessment

blocks.zh: 致癌物的 ADE 推算：無閾值模型
blocks.en: ADE Derivation for a Carcinogen: The No-Threshold Model

blocks.zh: Anti-neoplastic Agent C 屬於直接作用型基因毒性物質（direct acting genotoxic），不同於一般毒性物質使用 NOAEL ÷ 調整因子的方法。基因毒性致癌物通常採用線性無閾值外推（linear no-threshold extrapolation）：
blocks.en: Anti-neoplastic Agent C is a direct acting genotoxic substance. Unlike ordinary toxic substances, for which the NOAEL ÷ adjustment factor method is used, genotoxic carcinogens are usually treated with linear no-threshold extrapolation:

blocks.zh: 從動物或人類腫瘤數據推算癌症風險
blocks.en: Estimate the cancer risk from animal or human tumor data

blocks.zh: 選定可接受的超額癌症風險水準（此案為 1 × 10⁻⁵）
blocks.en: Select an acceptable level of excess cancer risk (1 × 10⁻⁵ in this case)

blocks.zh: 反推出對應的每日暴露量 = ADE = 1 μg/day
blocks.en: Back-calculate the corresponding daily exposure = ADE = 1 μg/day

blocks.zh: 這解釋了為何 ADE 比普通化合物低了 3 個數量級。
blocks.en: This explains why the ADE is 3 orders of magnitude lower than for ordinary compounds.

blocks.zh: 四條暴露途徑的評估架構
blocks.en: Assessment Framework for the Four Exposure Pathways

blocks.zh: Risk-MaPP 要求評估所有「合理可能的暴露途徑（plausible pathways）」：
blocks.en: Risk-MaPP requires assessment of all "plausible pathways" of exposure:

blocks.zh: Mix-up（混藥）：標籤錯誤、設備誤置 → 條碼管制
blocks.en: Mix-up: incorrect labels, misplaced equipment → barcode control

blocks.zh: Retention on product contact surfaces（殘留）：清洗不乾淨 → 清潔驗證
blocks.en: Retention on product contact surfaces: inadequate cleaning → cleaning validation

blocks.zh: Mechanical transfer（機械傳遞）：設備移動帶出污染 → 密閉系統
blocks.en: Mechanical transfer: contamination carried out by moving equipment → closed systems

blocks.zh: Airborne transfer（氣載傳遞）：揚塵或氣流帶出 → HVAC 設計
blocks.en: Airborne transfer: dust or airflow carrying contamination out → HVAC design

blocks.zh: 清潔可行性：初步令人放心
blocks.en: Cleanability: Initially Reassuring

blocks.zh: 注意：清潔可行性評估（cleanability rank = 2，最難清潔品為 4）顯示 Agent C 相對容易清洗，清潔劑也適用。這讓評估團隊最初以為清潔不是問題。但這只是化合物本質的清潔性，尚未考慮設備的幾何形狀與表面積帶來的挑戰。
blocks.en: Note: the cleanability assessment (cleanability rank = 2, with the hardest-to-clean product at 4) shows that Agent C is relatively easy to clean and that the cleaning agent is suitable. This led the assessment team to assume at first that cleaning was not a problem. But this reflects only the intrinsic cleanability of the compound and does not yet consider the challenges arising from the geometry and surface area of the equipment.

blocks.zh: Ppk 分析：從「數量」到「限值」的挑戰
blocks.en: Ppk Analysis: The Challenge from "Quantity" to "Limit"

blocks.zh: 想像清潔驗證就像射靶：現有設備一直射在靶心附近（Ppk 高），清潔表現穩定。但引入 Agent C 後，靶心的位置（清潔限值）移動到了之前從未達到的極小值。即使你的射擊精準度（製程能力）沒有改變，靶心太遠就是射不中。
blocks.en: Think of cleaning validation as target shooting: the existing equipment has been landing close to the bullseye (high Ppk), so cleaning performance is stable. But once Agent C is introduced, the bullseye (the cleaning limit) moves to an extremely small value never reached before. Even if your shooting accuracy (process capability) has not changed, a bullseye that far away simply cannot be hit.

blocks.zh: 情境二：關鍵發現與教訓
blocks.en: Scenario 2: Key Findings and Lessons

blocks.zh: 核心發現：V-Blender 成為阻斷因素
blocks.en: Core Finding: The V-Blender Becomes the Blocking Factor

blocks.zh: 整個情境二的轉折點在於 FMEA 清潔評估的量化數據：
blocks.en: The turning point of the whole of Scenario 2 is the quantitative data from the FMEA cleaning assessment:

blocks.zh: 除 V-Blender 以外，所有設備的清潔 Ppk 值高，ppm（缺陷率）趨近於零
blocks.en: For all equipment except the V-Blender, the cleaning Ppk values are high and the ppm (defect rate) approaches zero

blocks.zh: V-Blender 的 Ppk = 0.34（正常標準為 Ppk ≥ 1.33 表示能力充足）
blocks.en: The V-Blender has a Ppk = 0.34 (the normal standard is Ppk ≥ 1.33 for adequate capability)

blocks.zh: 對應的缺陷率 DPM = 14,994 ppm（即每百萬次清潔中有近 1.5 萬次無法達標）
blocks.en: The corresponding defect rate DPM = 14,994 ppm (i.e. nearly 15,000 out of every million cleanings fail to meet the target)

blocks.zh: 問題根源：V-Blender 表面積大，對 ADE = 1 μg/day 的化合物，清潔限值極低，遠超現有能力
blocks.en: Root cause: the V-Blender has a large surface area, and for a compound with an ADE = 1 μg/day the cleaning limit is extremely low, far beyond existing capability

blocks.zh: Ppk 數值的意義
blocks.en: What the Ppk Value Means

blocks.zh: 製程能力指數（Ppk）代表製程實際輸出相對於規格限值的能力：
blocks.en: The process performance index (Ppk) represents the ability of the actual process output relative to the specification limit:

blocks.zh: Ppk ≥ 1.33：製程能力良好（cGMP 通常要求）
blocks.en: Ppk ≥ 1.33: good process capability (usually required by cGMP)

blocks.zh: Ppk = 1.00：邊界值，約 0.27% 的失敗率
blocks.en: Ppk = 1.00: borderline, with a failure rate of about 0.27%

blocks.zh: Ppk = 0.34：嚴重不足，幾乎 1.5% 的批次清潔後殘留超標
blocks.en: Ppk = 0.34: seriously inadequate, with residues exceeding the limit after cleaning in almost 1.5% of batches

blocks.zh: 換算成患者風險：每 67 批（≈1000 ppm ÷ 14.994）就可能有一批清潔失敗，導致下一個產品被致癌物污染。
blocks.en: Converted into patient risk: roughly one in every 67 batches (≈1000 ppm ÷ 14.994) could have a cleaning failure, leaving the next product contaminated with a carcinogen.

blocks.zh: DoE 嘗試失敗：邊界在哪裡？
blocks.en: The DoE Attempt Fails: Where Is the Boundary?

blocks.zh: 評估團隊沒有輕易放棄。他們進行了正式的實驗設計（DoE），系統性地優化：
blocks.en: The assessment team did not give up easily. They carried out a formal design of experiments (DoE) to systematically optimize:

blocks.zh: 清潔劑濃度
blocks.en: Cleaning agent concentration

blocks.zh: 清潔時間
blocks.en: Cleaning time

blocks.zh: 清潔溫度
blocks.en: Cleaning temperature

blocks.zh: 沖洗時間
blocks.en: Rinse time

blocks.zh: DoE 結論：即使在最佳化條件下，V-Blender 就是無法被清潔至足夠安全的水準。這是設備幾何形狀（大表面積）與物理化學限制共同決定的結果，非 SOP 可以克服。
blocks.en: DoE conclusion: even under optimized conditions, the V-Blender simply cannot be cleaned to a sufficiently safe level. This results from the equipment geometry (large surface area) combined with physicochemical limits, and no SOP can overcome it.

blocks.zh: 最終決定：拒絕引入
blocks.en: Final Decision: Reject the Introduction

blocks.zh: 解決方案本可以是購買專用 V-Blender（dedication）——但廠房無法容納。在無法解決設備問題的情況下，業主做出了正確的決策：拒絕在此設施生產 Anti-neoplastic Agent C。
blocks.en: The solution could have been to buy a dedicated V-Blender (dedication), but the building could not accommodate it. With the equipment problem unresolved, the owner made the correct decision: to decline to manufacture Anti-neoplastic Agent C at this facility.

blocks.zh: 這本身是一個重要的監管信號：Risk-MaPP 流程的價值不在於「讓所有產品都能生產」，而在於提供科學依據拒絕無法安全生產的品項。
blocks.en: This is itself an important regulatory signal: the value of the Risk-MaPP process lies not in "enabling every product to be manufactured" but in providing the scientific basis to reject products that cannot be manufactured safely.

blocks.zh: Logic Diagram 完整路徑（情境二）
blocks.en: Complete Logic Diagram Path (Scenario 2)

blocks.zh: 步驟 1
blocks.en: Step 1

blocks.zh:
ADE = 1 μg/day → 屬高活性物質（HPAPI）
→ 需要工程控制 / FMEA
blocks.en:
ADE = 1 μg/day → a highly potent substance (HPAPI)
→ Engineering controls / FMEA required

blocks.zh: 步驟 2
blocks.en: Step 2

blocks.zh:
導入隔離器、SBV、once-through 通風 → 氣載、機械傳遞途徑受控
→ 表面上可以繼續
blocks.en:
Isolators, SBVs and once-through ventilation introduced → airborne and mechanical transfer pathways controlled
→ Appears able to proceed

blocks.zh: 步驟 3
blocks.en: Step 3

blocks.zh:
清潔 FMEA：V-Blender 表面積大，清潔限值超出歷史能力（Ppk = 0.34）
→ 關鍵風險識別：清潔無法達標
blocks.en:
Cleaning FMEA: the V-Blender has a large surface area and the cleaning limit exceeds historical capability (Ppk = 0.34)
→ Key risk identified: cleaning cannot meet the target

blocks.zh: 步驟 4
blocks.en: Step 4

blocks.zh:
DoE 嘗試優化 → 失敗；購買專用 Blender → 廠房無空間
→ 最終結論：無法引入，拒絕提案
blocks.en:
DoE optimization attempted → failed; dedicated blender purchase → no space in the building
→ Final conclusion: cannot be introduced, proposal rejected

blocks.zh: CDMO 核心教訓
blocks.en: Core Lessons for a CDMO

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 最重要的啟示：
blocks.en: The most important takeaways for a CDMO:

blocks.zh: 工程控制完備，不等於清潔驗證必然可達。兩者需要獨立評估。
blocks.en: Complete engineering controls do not mean cleaning validation will necessarily succeed. The two need to be assessed independently.

blocks.zh: 清潔驗證的挑戰不只是「能不能洗乾淨」，更要看設備幾何形狀（表面積）是否允許達到所需的清潔限值。
blocks.en: The challenge in cleaning validation is not only "can it be cleaned" but whether the equipment geometry (surface area) allows the required cleaning limit to be achieved.

blocks.zh: Ppk 分析是清潔風險量化的有效工具——不要只看「合格/不合格」，要看製程能力指數是否足夠應對新品的嚴格限值。
blocks.en: Ppk analysis is an effective tool for quantifying cleaning risk. Do not look only at "pass/fail"; look at whether the process capability index is sufficient to meet the strict limit of the new product.

blocks.zh: 能夠拒絕客戶要求（在科學依據下），本身就是 Risk-MaPP 系統發揮價值的體現。
blocks.en: Being able to turn down a client's request (on a scientific basis) is itself a demonstration of the Risk-MaPP system delivering value.

blocks.zh: 在報價或技術轉移評估早期，應先查清設施中最大表面積設備的歷史清潔 Ppk，再評估能否引入高活性化合物。
blocks.en: Early in the quotation or technology transfer assessment, first check the historical cleaning Ppk of the equipment with the largest surface area in the facility, and only then assess whether a highly potent compound can be introduced.

blocks.zh: 情境一 vs. 情境二：比較總結
blocks.en: Scenario 1 vs. Scenario 2: Comparison Summary

blocks.zh: 決定性差異：數量級跳躍觸發不同評估路徑
blocks.en: The Deciding Difference: A Jump in Order of Magnitude Triggers a Different Assessment Path

blocks.zh: 兩個情境使用同一個設施，評估結果截然相反。關鍵在於：
blocks.en: The two scenarios use the same facility, yet the assessment results are completely opposite. The key points are:

blocks.zh: 情境一：新 ADE（0.3）與現有最低 ADE（0.5）在同一數量級，現有系統可覆蓋。
blocks.en: Scenario 1: the new ADE (0.3) and the lowest existing ADE (0.5) are of the same order of magnitude, and the existing system can cover it.

blocks.zh: 情境二：新 ADE（0.001）低了兩到三個數量級，觸發完全不同的工程控制要求，且進一步發現清潔設備的物理限制無法克服。
blocks.en: Scenario 2: the new ADE (0.001) is two to three orders of magnitude lower, triggering entirely different engineering control requirements, and further analysis reveals physical limits of the cleaning equipment that cannot be overcome.

blocks.zh: 本章的核心訊息
blocks.en: Core Message of This Chapter

blocks.zh: 不要以「看起來有嚴格工程控制 = 可以引入」作為評估終點。Risk-MaPP 要求你系統性地走完所有路徑——特別是清潔驗證的製程能力量化分析——才能得出真正基於科學的結論。
blocks.en: Do not treat "strict-looking engineering controls = can be introduced" as the end point of the assessment. Risk-MaPP requires you to work systematically through all pathways, especially the quantitative process capability analysis of cleaning validation, in order to reach a conclusion that is truly science-based.

blocks.zh: 給監管審查員的信號
blocks.en: A Signal to Regulatory Reviewers

blocks.zh: 情境二最終的主動拒絕（self-rejection）本身就是品質文化成熟度的體現。監管機構最希望看到的是：企業能在問題變成缺陷前，用科學方法找到邊界，並做出正確決策——不論那個決策是否有利於商業利益。
blocks.en: The ultimate self-rejection in Scenario 2 is itself evidence of a mature quality culture. What regulators most want to see is a company that can use scientific methods to find the boundary before a problem becomes a defect, and make the right decision, whether or not that decision serves its commercial interests.
